language.name: Classical Latin
language.coverageNote: Starter study lexicon (72 authored words) plus 2928 Latin core lemmas assembled from Diederich's frequency study, the Dickinson College Commentaries core list, OCR/Leaving Certificate pedagogical lists, and a short-headword Lewis & Short extension to reach 3,000. Each entry has three constructed examples.
language.licenseNote: Authored starter data and constructed examples were compiled for Bayt al-Hikmah. Diederich's word list is used from the Hiberna Caroli Raetici edition (CC BY-SA 3.0); DCC core vocabulary is CC BY-SA; Lewis & Short is public domain. The bundled EB Garamond font is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
sources: Paul B. Diederich, The Frequency of Latin Words and Their Endings (1939), Hiberna Caroli Raetici edition
